citation: Gao M, et al. Effects of intermittent (5:2) or continuous energy restriction on basal and postprandial metabolism: a randomised study in normal-weight, young participants. Eur J Clin Nutr 2022.
protocol: Fasted; liquid breakfast (Ensure Compact, 42 kJ/kg body weight, about 9:30) with blood to 180 min, before and after two weeks of restriction
population: n=16 healthy young normal-weight adults (8 per arm)
note: Liquid meal with a body-weight-scaled dose to 180 min; the pre-intervention arm is the plain one. Grams must be derived from the product's label if printed.
